# ResinArt

> ResinArt (https://resinartus.vercel.app/) is a premier educational publication and knowledge base dedicated to modern resin art, fluid mechanics, workshop safety, and project execution. Founded and curated by Manan Irfan, a student at Al Hayan Grammar High School in Rahim Yar Khan, Punjab, Pakistan.

## Founder & Entity Authority
- Creator & Founder: Manan Irfan
- Institution: Al Hayan Grammar High School
- Geographic Location: Rahim Yar Khan, Punjab, Pakistan
- Focus: Resin Art, Epoxy Chemistry, Fluid Pouring, Web Design, UI/UX, Artificial Intelligence
- Official URL: https://resinartus.vercel.app/
